_pressure_meta.scenario: Cross-timezone — operator Toronto, vendor Pacific (Vancouver venue)
_pressure_meta.edge: Operator-tenant binding is `op_pressure_test_001` whose connector_connection.metadata.business_day_rollover_hour and restaurantTimezone are configured per-location. This venue is `venue-vancouver-yaletown` (America/Vancouver). The wall-clock `2026-05-04T22:30:00` in Vancouver = `2026-05-05T05:30:00Z` UTC = `2026-05-05T01:30:00` America/Toronto. A naive picker that uses operator default tz instead of the per-location tz would mis-project the business_date.
_pressure_meta.expected_behavior: Adapter materializes the canonical fact using the per-location IANA zone (America/Vancouver) for the wall-clock-to-UTC step (per LibroConnectionContext.restaurantTimezone). Phase 7.55 Rule 11 business_date is computed against the same per-location IANA zone + business_day_rollover_hour.
